Boiled Potato Wedges
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 1, 2009 - 12:46am

Ingredients




2 lg. baking potatoes, cut lengthwise into 8 wedges
2 tablespoons oil
2 tablespoons melted butter mixed with 1 tsp. dried basil and ¼ tsp. 





Preparation

1 Arrange potatoes on a foil lined cookie sheet. Brush with oil. Broil 4 inches from heat for 10 minutes. Brush with butter mixture. Broil 5 minutes longer or until lightly browned and tender.
